title: Build a support desk workspace
description: Set up a support inbox with an open-tickets queue, an urgent view, and one-click resolution.
problem: Support agents need a shared queue of open tickets, a fast way to spot urgent ones, and their own assigned tickets, without every agent seeing the same unfiltered list.
summary: Define a workspace with defineWorkspace containing open, urgent, and resolved views, a badge counting open tickets, and a resolve action.
runtimeNotes: Declarative workspace and mutation actions. The urgent badge uses a static aggregate filter; per-agent filtering is not covered here.
intents: show open ticket count in navigation
